about.intro: Passionate Frontend Web Developer crafting performant, pixel-perfect, and accessible digital experiences.
about.description: I bridge design and modern technology to build fast, scalable, and responsive web applications with clean code architecture.
about.full:
Hi, I'm Abdul Khalil, a dedicated Frontend Web Developer with a strong focus on crafting aesthetic, user-centered web applications. My core expertise revolves around modern frontend stack including React, Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

I specialize in transforming Figma and visual designs into clean, responsive, and interactive code. From fluid UI animations using Framer Motion to smooth page interactions and efficient layout structures, I ensure every project is optimized for performance and accessibility.

Whether working on dynamic web applications, custom client landing pages, or scalable portfolio components, I am committed to writing structured, maintainable code and delivering top-tier digital interfaces.

projects.title: Personal Portfolio Website
projects.description: A modern, animated personal portfolio built to showcase my work, featuring smooth scroll-driven interactions, custom cursor effects, and a fully responsive multilingual design.

projects.title: Travel Agency Landing Page
projects.description: An interactive travel booking landing page designed with fluid animations, destination packages display, dynamic search filters, and mobile responsiveness.
